candidate_policy: The triggering repository uses its checked-out candidate; the counterpart uses this exact revision. Record both actual revisions and dirty state.
planned_controls_policy: Declared by Phase 5 slice 5.0. Not required and not run until the owning slice moves the id into required_controls.
known_defect_policy: No baseline defects remain after Phase 1 containment. Resolved defects are required passing isolation controls, never xfail/skip. Passing this suite does not mean SaaS readiness.
